svg.text: Amber: interior work deck / access bridges at Z=0.
Blue: west gallery +3.2; east bus trench −1.2.
Gray pit has no ordinary standing route.
Outer ring is machine space, not a second walk loop.
Full shell 0–200°; lower shell / temporary deck 200–360°.
Gallery port view is separated from A view by a 2.4m screen.
Rear exits turn into site; rear band has no plant sightline.
Dimensions show intent; compiled exposure is still open.
T exits → Cleanlock / Cooling / S bridge; Cleanlock → Cask; Cask stairs → gallery; A south / W-port / rear entries.
S bridge → open work arc; enclosed north arc → E/W ports; E-port → Power west entry; trench ramps → B south.
Gallery port aperture → lower W port; gallery A aperture → Hot Cell; A/B rear turns → Rear Services.
Overhead: roofed peripheral wings at 4.8m; reactor hall roof at 16m, crane at 12m. Views use deliberate cutaways.
